name: uziel awret
abstract: John Searle has identified three features of consciousness that need to be explained by a scientific theory - Subjectivity, Unity and Qualitativeness. Already in 2003 Chalmers and Bayne divided the unity of consciousness into Access Unity and Phenomenal Unity. Among other things the prospects of machine consciousness depend on the unity of ‘virtual agent’. While virtual access unity is conceivable, attributing phenomenal unity to a virtual agent is harder to imagine. Chalmers and Bayne consider
field: Philosophy of consciousness, phenomenal unity, physics of consciousness
notable: Edited special singularity edition of Journal of Consciousness Studies; published in Frontiers in Systems Neuroscience; appeared on Closer to Truth
notes: Developing dual-aspect theory of consciousness based on holographic duality.
